title: Notice periods are read from the contract, never assumed
content: The notice period used for any reminder comes from the contract's own termination clause, quoted with its clause number. No default notice period is ever assumed, and a period stated in months is treated as calendar months rather than converted to days. Where an amendment or addendum changes the term, the latest signed document governs.

title: What the decision date means
content: The decision date is the last day on which notice can still be given in time to stop a contract renewing: the renewal date minus the notice period stated in the contract. It is the date every reminder is anchored to, because the renewal date itself is already too late to act on.
